name: Admin Toolbar Messages
description: Splits Drupal's status messages raised on admin routes out of the page and shows them in the classic Toolbar or the Drupal 11 Navigation top bar once the user is on a front-end (non-admin) page.

suggests.drupal:toolbar: Provides the classic Toolbar; the module adds a right-aligned messages tab/drawer here via hook_toolbar().
suggests.drupal:navigation: Provides the Drupal 11 Navigation top bar; the module registers an 'Administrative Status Messages' TopBarItem plugin in the Actions region.
suggests.drupal/admin_toolbar: Recommended companion that enhances the administration toolbar this module integrates with (no hard dependency).
suggests.drupal/gin_toolbar: When both navigation and gin_toolbar are enabled, library_info_alter swaps in Gin-specific navigation CSS.

project_description: Split of and display administrative status messages as part of the site Toolbar.
